Occidental Petroleum (OXY) Shareholder Financial Counselors Cut Its Holding as Market Valuation Declined; Apple (AAPL) Stake Increased by Noesis Capital Mangement Corp 
April 16, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Financial Counselors Inc decreased its stake in Occidental Petroleum Corp (OXY) by 65.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Financial Counselors Inc sold 8,245 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,429 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $326,000, down from 12,674 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Financial Counselors Inc who had been investing in Occidental Petroleum Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.26B market cap company. The stock increased 1.58% or $1.16 during the last trading session, reaching $74.79. About 2.37M shares traded. Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has risen 4.69% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.86% the S&P500. 
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22M, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $892.62 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Financial Counselors Inc, which manages about $2.18 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Baxter Intl Inc (NYSE:BAX) by 8,712 shares to 119,115 shares, valued at $7.70M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Spdr S&P 600 Small Cap Etf (SLY) by 2,667 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,819 shares, and has risen its stake in Conagra Brands Inc (NYSE:CAG). 
Analysts await Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) to report earnings on May, 3. They expect $0.66 earnings per share, up 340.00% or $0.51 from last year’s $0.15 per share. OXY’s profit will be $505.34M for 28.33 P/E if the $0.66 EPS becomes a reality.
